v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas, allelúia.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths, alleluia.

r.la: Et osténdit illi regnum Dei, allelúia.
r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God, alleluia.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui, allelúia.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Philíppum Confessórem tuum Sanctórum tuórum glória sublimásti: concéde propítius; ut, cuius solemnitáte lætámur, eius virtútum proficiámus exémplo.
text.en: O God, who hast exalted thy blessed Confessor Philip to the glory of thy saints be appeased and grant that as we rejoice in his feast we may profit by the example of his virtues.

text.la: Fíliæ Ierúsalem, veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Daughters of Jerusalem, come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Eleuthérium Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Eleutherius thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.
